name: tg-bridge
description: A pane in Claude Desktop's Code tab with the Telegram group linked to the project, through a bot of your own: puts the group's messages, pictures and files into the prompt and sends Claude's replies to the group formatted. Calls api.telegram.org with the bot token pasted in the pane; downloads pictures and files with curl into ~/.claude/tg-bridge/files; runs git to find a worktree's project and grep for the desktop's language.

botToken.title: Telegram bot token
botToken.description: The token BotFather gave the bot (123456:ABC...). Turn the bot's privacy mode off in BotFather (/setprivacy → Disable) so it sees every message of the group.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the Telegram pane at the start of every session of a project linked to a group.
